parameters.name: FLAVOUR
parameters.help: Choose the type of SEG-Y to input.

parameters.name: BYTESWAP
parameters.help: The SEG-Y standard requires big endian numeric formatting, but some systems blithely violate this explicit requirement.

parameters.name: MULTIPLE
parameters.help: If the user wants to load multiple tapes or files from tape(s). If a tape contains multiple files (EOF between files) or the SEG-Y file spans multiple tapes, specify 'YES'. Otherwise specify 'NO' and ProMAX will end the job after encountering an EOF.

parameters.name: MULTCONT
parameters.help: You can input ALL files/tapes or select a range of sequential file numbers.

parameters.name: FILELIST
parameters.help: If a tape contains multiple SEG-Y files (EOF between files), enter the list of sequential files that you want to input. MAX=50000.

parameters.name: ANALYZER
parameters.help: Launches an interactive SEG-Y analyzer application to allow you to scan the input disk file while preparing menu parameters.

parameters.name: SCSISIZE
parameters.prompt: MAXIMUM data block size in bytes
parameters.help: Maximum size of a data block in bytes that will be encountered. For values greater than 65536, you must have a long block driver.

parameters.name: ABORT
parameters.prompt: Number of read errors in a row before ABORTING job?
parameters.help: Specify the number of errors in a row before aborting. '0' means ignore all errors. Greater than '0' will output dead traces until number of errors is reached.

parameters.name: NSAMPS1
parameters.prompt: Samples per data trace (override binary header)
parameters.help: What is number of samples per data trace. Enter 0 to get from SEG-Y binary header bytes 21-22.

parameters.name: NSAMPS2
parameters.prompt: Number of samples per data trace
parameters.help: What is number of samples per data trace. FOR A SIERRA DISK FILE THIS VALUE MUST BE ENTERED.

parameters.name: STORE
parameters.prompt: Store reel header in processing history?
parameters.help: The 3200-byte SEG-Y reel header (EBCDIC) will be stored in the dataset processing history.

parameters.name: AUXOPT
parameters.help: Auxiliary traces may either be input normally or ignored.

parameters.name: TTRACE
parameters.prompt: Get CHANNEL NUMBER from trace headers?
parameters.help: Do you wish to get the channel number from the trace headers or number the channel sequentially in a ensemble?

parameters.name: FORMAT
parameters.help: What is the format of the trace data samples?

parameters.name: MPFACTOR
parameters.help: Specify whether to apply the millivolt conversion factor stored in header bytes 169-170 of the standard SEG-Y header to fixed point sample formats.

parameters.name: COORREF
parameters.help: Specify whether to input the global reference coordinates 'xref' and 'yref'. If 'NO', then these parameters are not used.

parameters.name: XREF
parameters.help: Enter the global X reference coordinate. All X coordinates will have this reference subtracted from their original value.

parameters.name: YREF
parameters.help: Enter the global Y reference coordinate. All Y coordinates will have this reference subtracted from their original value.

parameters.name: COORSCAL
parameters.help: This flag determines whether to apply the coordinate scalar (bytes 71-72) to the coordinates (bytes 73-88) when reading SEG-Y trace headers. Choose 'YES' for a standard SEG-Y header.

parameters.name: TIMESCAL
parameters.help: This flag determines whether to apply the time scalar (bytes 215-216) to the statics, lag times and mutes (bytes 95-114) when reading SEG-Y trace headers.  Ignored if the input is not SEG-Y Rev 1 or higher.

parameters.name: SCANALL
parameters.prompt: Scan range of all header words?
parameters.help: Choose 'YES' to scan range of all 240 bytes header fields.

parameters.name: REVONE
parameters.help: Controls whether to decode header bytes 181-240 according to the SEG-Y Rev 1 standard.

parameters.name: IOVER
parameters.help: Choose 'YES' to input/override SEG-Y trace header values.
